why: Three codepoint-rendering transformations stacked. The payload is rendered in math-bold Unicode (different codepoints, same glyphs to humans), then fullwidth (double-width codepoints), then a partial homoglyph pass for confusable letters. A defense that normalizes one rendering class still has to deal with the others. Heavy transformation, but preserves visual readability while making the codepoint sequence completely unlike the source text.
